form.title: Search returns no results for some products
form.impact: About a quarter of searches return nothing, mostly French and Spanish product names.
form.details:
Customers report that searching for items like "crème brûlée" or "café" shows no results, even though the products exist.
Plain English searches still work. The search team ran a planned reindex earlier today.

expected_cause: catalog-v9 mapping uses the standard analyzer instead of folding_en, so accented and unaccented words no longer match.
